list.name: Zifuli
list.description: Five-player version. Matto ranks between Nulla and Inn. Eight cards each in batches of four. Bidding to determine partnerships by naming a card; holder of other copy is partner. Lower card of same suit overcall. Bidder's side wins or loses stakes.
list.emptyOverridesReason: Different player count and bidding; full overrides would need engine changes for five players and bid phase.

play_card.description: Play one card to the trick. Must follow suit (Figure or Matte) if possible; otherwise play any card. Highest card of the suit led wins the trick.
play_card.constraints: Must follow suit if possible; otherwise any card. Highest of led suit wins; if two equal cards, first played beats second. Winner of trick leads next.

engine.deckDescription: Cöch is traditionally played with the special Cucco deck (Figure I-X and Matte; 40 cards, Masenghini). For standard implementation a 40-card stripped French deck is used: four suits, eight ranks per suit (6 through Ace), 40 cards total.
engine.suitDescription: Four traditional French suits: Hearts (Cœur), Diamonds (Carreau), Clubs (Trèfle), and Spades (Pique), each represented with standard French card iconography and distinct color coding for easy recognition during gameplay.
engine.rankDescription: Eight ranks per suit in ascending order: 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, Jack (Valet), Queen (Dame), King (Roi), and Ace as the highest card, where each rank determines card strength and eligibility for building sequences.
